'''Uta T'Cha's workshop''' was located next to the [[droid gladiatorial arena]] in the town of [[Ghaz Kul IV]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pitann]]. [[Uta T'Cha]] used the workshop as her base of operations when developing a remote control system to take control of any [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sho'ban Do]]. She also used the workshop to modify droids for the [[Pitann droid gladiatorial games|droid gladiatorial contests]].
